what: Inside the area, a pill with a flowing text band follows the cursor (.35s late). On leaving it shrinks to .6x and vanishes, and on press it is pressed down to .85x. On touch devices it stays at the top center of the area · look: disc is a blurred disc with a ring (142px) holding text and an arrow, and lag: 0 makes it stick to the hand position at once (kj8 campaign card row DRAG)

options.text: Text flowing in the pill, default ”Drag to explore”
options.loop: Text band loop time (seconds), default 4. At 0 one set of text stays centered and only cursor follow and press remain
options.label: Selector (e.g. [data-label]). Shows in a pill the data-label of the child under the cursor (falling back to data-tag, then to its text). If empty, text
options.lag: Trailing delay (sec), default .35 — 0 attaches instantly with no curve (kj8)
options.look: disc — ring-wrapped blurred disc type (one text set + arrow, doesn’t flow) · tag — dark ink rectangular band (max 180px) with a left arrow cell and flowing uppercase text (frost: look: tag; lerp: .1; fade: .1; leave: 1; loop: 8; label: [data-tag])
options.press: Scale while pressed, default .85 — kj8 is .9
options.leave: Scale it shrinks to on exit, default .6 — kj8 is 1 (opacity only)
options.lerp: Chase the remaining distance by this fraction each frame (0–1) instead of a curve, default 0 (off) — frost .1
options.fade: On and off duration (s), default .3 — frost .1

from.where: index.js .m-cursor (cursor band over the testimonial board)

index.html #kj-campaign-drug — original campaign card row: on every pointermove, gsap.set puts the circle center at the pointer (no delay), opacity .3s ease-out on enter, scale .9 .2s ease-out on press, circle 142px · ring 6px outside · blur 7px
from.use: data-fx-cursor-ticker="look: disc; lag: 0; press: .9; leave: 1; text: DRAG"

from.where: shared.js .fr-cursor — over a work card, a dark band flowing with that card’s word (data-tag) follows by 1/10 each step
